module.name: prefer-structured-clone
module.description: Report JSON cloning patterns for manual review because structuredClone can change values.

scenarios.name: should allow direct structuredClone and ordinary JSON parsing
should allow parse revivers and stringify replacers
scenarios.given: JSON.parse with a reviver or JSON.stringify with a replacer

scenarios.name: should report a direct JSON clone without autofix
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the outer call
scenarios.then: a preferStructuredClone violation is reported without rewriting the call

scenarios.name: should preserve dropped undefined properties
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the outer call
scenarios.then: no autofix changes which properties survive cloning

scenarios.name: should preserve date serialization
scenarios.when: the rule evaluates the outer call
scenarios.then: no autofix changes a serialized date string into a Date object
